cc:Work.dc:title: Current and power scaling
cc:Work.dc:description: Current and output power rise across N=1-4; the N=2 point aggregates M0+M1 and M2+M3, the N=3 point aggregates M0+M1+M2 and M1+M2+M3, and the N=4 point uses the new record. Dashed lines to N=8 are unvalidated extrapolations.
